# Bid the pit, the discharge, and the backup.

> Price a sump-pump install from pit type, extra discharge past the included first fifteen feet, battery or water-powered backup, alarm, and freeze protection — not a published $450 swap special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
